==Biography==
Before Kyohei "'''Ceros'''" Yoshida played League of Legends, he played a first-person shooter called 鉄鬼. Together with [[Zerost]], he won the game's official online competition.<ref>[http://www.4gamer.net/games/025/G002511/20100823012/ Report for Sudden Attack and 鉄鬼 offline event] ''www.4gamer.net''</ref>

== Trivia ==
* His goal is to become the [[Faker]] of Japan.
* Known for his unconventional off-meta picks such as {{ci|Ziggs}}, {{ci|Heimerdinger}}, and {{ci|Zilean}}.
* He was chosen as the '''IWC Player of the Year''' by Team Liquid.<ref>[http://www.liquidlegends.net/forum/lol-general/501885-2015-league-of-legends-awards#iwc 2015 League of Legends Awards] ''www.liquidlegends.net''</ref>
* He is called '''皇帝''' (Emperor) in Japan.
* He and his longtime teammate [[Yutapon]] have the distinction of being tied for the second-longest continuous tenure of any player with a single organization, behind only [[Faker]], who joined [[SK Telecom T1 2]] a month and a day before the two of them joined DetonatioN FocusMe.
